<h1 className={"openapi__heading"}>Move a dashboard to a different folder</h1>

<MethodEndpoint method={"put"} path={"/perses-public/api/v1/dashboards/move"}></MethodEndpoint>



Moves a dashboard, and all of its stored versions, from one folder to another.

`dashboardId` is the dashboard's `uid`. All three properties are required.

The response acknowledges the move with the dashboard's current version row `id`. That value is not a new handle: keep addressing the dashboard by the `uid` you sent.
